handler.query: SELECT name, value, help, type, labels FROM ( SELECT 'basketline_newest_event_age_seconds' AS name, toFloat64(dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now64(3))) AS value, 'Seconds since ClickHouse last stored an event' AS help, 'gauge' AS type, CAST(map(), 'Map(String, String)') AS labels FROM analytics.events UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_hourly_check_failed', toFloat64(ifNull(exception, '') != ''), '1 when the last run of an hourly check failed', 'gauge', map('view', view) FROM system.view_refreshes WHERE database = 'analytics' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_hourly_check_age_seconds', toFloat64(dateDiff('second', ifNull(last_success_time, toDateTime(0)), now())), 'Seconds since an hourly check last succeeded', 'gauge', map('view', view) FROM system.view_refreshes WHERE database = 'analytics' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_backup_age_seconds', toFloat64(dateDiff('second', max(event_time), now())), 'Seconds since the newest completed backup (a very large value: none yet)', 'gauge', CAST(map(), 'Map(String, String)') FROM system.backup_log WHERE status = 'BACKUP_CREATED' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_clickhouse_kafka_errors_10m', toFloat64(arrayCount(t -> t > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, exceptions.time)), 'Kafka engine errors in the last 10 minutes, per queue table', 'gauge', map('table', table) FROM system.kafka_consumers WHERE database = 'analytics' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_store_events_last_hour', toFloat64(count()), 'Impressions and clicks stored in the last hour, per store', 'gauge', map('tenant', toString(tenant_id), 'store', toString(store_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE ingested_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY tenant_id, store_id ) ORDER BY name FORMAT Prometheus
